<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sites"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds a Site to the warehouse map. The site code becomes the first segment of every LocationCode inside the facility, so it must be uppercase alphanumeric and unique across the service. Site code uniqueness is enforced here in the application layer rather than in the aggregate: a single aggregate cannot see its siblings. A newly registered Site is Active, and publishes SiteRegistered.

  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":false,"description":"Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0019). Clients MUST always send a non-empty, unique-per-submit key: the header is required whenever the service runs with Postgres — i.e. in every deployment — and an absent or empty key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`. A replay with the same key and the same body returns the original response verbatim; the same key with a different body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`. It is declared `required: false` here only because the in-memory development mode (no DATABASE_URL) does not enforce the middleware and the Schemathesis contract run boots that mode.","schema":{"type":"string","example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
